title: Recovery: 1953c batch-sweep backfill + 1953f/1953b-2 EPIPE handler in pdfOcrWorker

test_file.rationale: Complete, 8/8 GREEN, covers TC-1..TC-6b (cron expression, wrapRun key contract, sweep callback, earnings-season guard, all-quarter coverage). Meaningful regression protection.

pdfOcrWorker.rationale: The prior agent already applied the EPIPE fix. The modification addresses the 1953b-2 / 1953f EPIPE blocker. Fix verified complete (see pdfOcrWorker_epipe_fix below).

fix_1953c.root_cause: Container was down at 2026-04-25T09:00 UTC. Job IS correctly registered in startScheduler.ts. No code wiring bug. Next auto-fire: 2026-07-25T09:00:00Z.

files.description: One-shot Q1-2026 BCTC queue backfill. INSERT OR IGNORE for all watchlist tickers. Idempotent. Callable via: bun run apps/mcp-server/src/scheduler/financial-reports/backfillBctcQ12026.ts

fix_1953c.backfill_trigger: ops runs AFTER 1953b container rebuilt + EPIPE fix deployed. bctcQueueEnricherJob + bctcPdfPullJob then process automatically.

fix_1953b2_epipe.crash_location: pdfOcrWorker.ts:176 (old line numbering) — tess.stdin.write(chunk) after tesseract process exited
fix_1953b2_epipe.symptom: EPIPE broken-pipe crash on multi-page PDFs (36-76 pages). Container restarts. GAS/EIB/DHG/FPT Q1-2026 OCR never completes.

fix_applied.layer_1: tess.stdin.on('error', ...) — swallows EPIPE silently; re-logs any other error code via logger.warn
fix_applied.layer_2: writable guard in ppm.stdout 'data' handler — only writes to tess.stdin if !tessExited && tess.stdin.writable && !tess.stdin.destroyed
fix_applied.layer_3: tess 'close' handler sets tessExited=true and calls tess.stdin.destroy() to close any in-flight write path immediately
fix_applied.approach: Minimal — no refactor of worker architecture. Targeted stream lifecycle hardening.

commit_message: fix(sprint-1953c+f): bctcBatchSweep backfill helper + EPIPE handler in pdfOcrWorker

steps: 1. Rebuild container (docker compose build mcp-server) — includes Dockerfile OCR deps from 1953b
3. Verify: docker run --rm mcp-server:latest which pdftoppm tesseract
4. Run backfill: docker exec <container> bun run apps/mcp-server/src/scheduler/financial-reports/backfillBctcQ12026.ts
5. Retry OCR: trigger bctcReparseJob for GAS, EIB, DHG, FPT — verify no EPIPE crash, financial_reports rows appear
6. Monitor: docker logs --tail 100 <container> | grep ocr — should see page-by-page progress, no EPIPE
